visual_design_choices: An Iron Age Judean hill city of pale limestone around 600 BC, olive trees on the surrounding hills
architecture: tightly packed flat-roofed stone houses, narrow stepped lanes, thick city walls and gates
locked_traits: Never domes, minarets, or later-era towers

scriptural_facts.text: Lehi pitched his tent in a valley by the side of a river of water that emptied into the Red Sea, and called it the valley of Lemuel.

visual_design_choices: A narrow green valley along a flowing river among rocky red-brown desert mountains near the Red Sea, the family's tents beside the water
Arid wilderness near the Red Sea: rocky red-brown mountains, dry wadis and sand, sparse acacia and scrub, goat-hair tents
locked_traits: Never horses or wagons; travel is on foot

scriptural_facts.text: They came to a land by the seashore that they called Bountiful because of its much fruit and wild honey; the sea was called Irreantum.

visual_design_choices: A fertile seashore of palms and fruit trees beside a wide sea, a high mountain nearby, the family's tents and a large timber ship being built by hand
A large hand-built timber sailing ship with a square sail on the open ocean
locked_traits: Never metal hulls, cannons, or modern rigging

scriptural_facts.text: They pitched their tents in the promised land and found forests with beasts of every kind, and ore of gold, silver and copper.

visual_design_choices: An untouched green New World coastline and forest with open fields, the family's first tents and simple huts
locked_traits: Never cities or temples here yet

scriptural_facts.text: Nephi's people built buildings and a temple after the manner of the temple of Solomon, though not so costly.

visual_design_choices: Green highland valleys with terraced fields around a young settlement
architecture: timber-and-stone houses and a modest stone temple after the manner of Solomon's temple

visual_design_choices: A broad green river valley along the river Sidon with fields and forest
architecture: a prosperous city of plastered stone buildings, stepped stone platform temples and timber palisades, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

scriptural_facts.text: King Noah built many elegant and spacious buildings ornamented with fine work of wood and precious things, a spacious palace, and a very high tower near the temple.

visual_design_choices: Highland valleys of the land of Nephi with fields and forest
architecture: a walled city of stone buildings ornamented with carved wood and gold, a spacious palace, a high tower near the temple, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

scriptural_facts.text: A fountain of pure water near a thicket of small trees, where Alma hid from the king and baptized.

visual_design_choices: A clear pool of pure water beside a thicket of small trees at the edge of a forest

scriptural_facts.text: A very beautiful and pleasant land of pure water, where Alma's people built a city.

visual_design_choices: A beautiful and pleasant land of pure water, fields and wooded hills
architecture: a small new city of plain timber and stone buildings

visual_design_choices: Green highland valleys with Lamanite towns, fields, forest and pastures of the king's flocks
architecture: thatched timber halls and a king's court on a stepped stone platform, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

visual_design_choices: A dry valley in the land of Ammonihah
architecture: a proud Nephite city of plastered stone buildings with a judgment hall and walls, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

scriptural_facts.text: The Zoramites built synagogues with a place for standing high above the head, whose top admitted only one person; it was called Rameumptom.

visual_design_choices: The rich Zoramite land of Antionum by the sea
architecture: ornate synagogues with a high narrow stand whose top holds one person, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

scriptural_facts.text: Moroni fortified the Nephite cities with ridges of earth, works of timbers, a frame of pickets, and towers.

visual_design_choices: War-time Nephite borderlands of fields, forest and wilderness
architecture: earthen ridges topped with timber walls and pickets, watch towers, trenches around the cities
locked_traits: Never stone castles or European fortifications

scriptural_facts.text: A great multitude gathered together round about the temple in the land Bountiful.

visual_design_choices: A broad open plaza around the temple in the land Bountiful, green trees beyond
architecture: a stepped Nephite temple platform of pale stone, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

visual_design_choices: War-torn Nephite lands: fortified hills, smoke on the horizon, armies camped
architecture: fortified stone towns, some burned, Mesoamerican-inspired architecture

scriptural_facts.text: The Nephites pitched their tents round about the hill Cumorah, in a land of many waters, rivers, and fountains.

visual_design_choices: A great green hill in a land of many waters, rivers and fountains, tents and armies encamped around it
Dense green forest, highland ridges and rivers of the New World wilderness

scriptural_facts.text: Jared and his brother went down into the valley called Nimrod with their flocks, seeds and families.

visual_design_choices: An ancient Mesopotamian valley with herds and flocks and goat-hair tents, and far off on the horizon the great tower: a colossal unfinished ziggurat of sun-baked ochre mud brick, seven broad stepped tiers each smaller than the one below, a long straight stairway ramp climbing the center of the front face, dark bitumen mortar lines between the bricks, its flat unfinished top wrapped in rough wooden scaffolding
architecture: Ancient Mesopotamian mud-brick architecture only: ziggurat tiers, flat roofs, no arches or domes

scriptural_facts.text: They pitched their tents by the seashore and called the place Moriancumer.

visual_design_choices: A wide seashore camp of tents where the Jaredites dwelt beside the great sea

scriptural_facts.text: The brother of Jared carried sixteen small stones, white and clear as transparent glass, to the top of the exceedingly high mount Shelem.

visual_design_choices: The rocky top of an exceedingly high mountain above the sea and clouds

scriptural_facts.text: The barges were small and light upon the water, peaked at the ends, and tight like unto a dish.

visual_design_choices: Small tight wooden barges shaped like a dish, peaked at the ends, tossed on huge ocean waves
locked_traits: Never sails, masts, or ordinary ships

visual_design_choices: Ancient New World kingdoms of the Jaredites: plains, hills and forests
architecture: massive stone palaces and fortresses with bold geometric carvings and obsidian ornament

scriptural_facts.text: Jared and his brother came forth from the great tower when the Lord confounded the language of the people.

visual_design_choices: A flat, dry ancient Mesopotamian plain at the foot of the great tower: a colossal unfinished ziggurat of sun-baked ochre mud brick, seven broad stepped tiers each smaller than the one below, a long straight stairway ramp climbing the center of the front face, dark bitumen mortar lines between the bricks, its flat unfinished top wrapped in rough wooden scaffolding
Mud-brick kilns, brick stacks and workers' tents at its base, the river plain beyond
architecture: Ancient Mesopotamian mud-brick architecture only: ziggurat tiers, flat roofs, no arches or domes
locked_traits: The tower is always this same seven-tiered ochre ziggurat with the central stairway and the scaffolded unfinished top
Never a round, spiral, or Gothic tower; never Mesoamerican
